https://www.delfi.lt/en/business/next-su.text: Delfi EN Delfi Business 2026.09.01 17:59 Next summer, airBaltic will fly to 8 destinations from Vilnius Translated by Karolis Broga Source: Elta EN Next summer, airBaltic will fly to 8 destinations from Vilnius PHOTO: Dalius Pacevičius | Delfi Follow Delfi on Google The Latvian airline airBaltic has presented its flight programme for the 2027 summer season, lasting from the end of March to the end of October next year. Riga will continue to be airBaltic’s primary hub with the widest range of direct destinations, whereas Estonia’s capital Tallinn and Lithuania’s capital Vilnius will complement the network with selected point-to-point services. The airline announced that it would focus its operations "on markets with the strongest demand and revenue potential to business and leisure destinations". At the same time, it would increase flight frequencies to key destinations to provide more flexibility to passengers. Throughout 2027, airBaltic plans to operate flights to more than 100 destinations. In the summer 2027 season, airBaltic will offer 57 direct destinations from Riga, 13 from Tallinn and 8 from Vilnius. The airline will fly from Vilnius to Amsterdam, Dusseldorf, Hamburg, Lisbon, Munich, Paris, Riga, and Tallinn.
